usage: music-tagger replaygain [-h] [--dry-run] [--skip-existing]
                               [--track-only] [--log LOG | --no-log]
                               path

Compute and write ReplayGain 2.0 tags via rsgain.

positional arguments:
  path             Album directory.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --dry-run        Show gains without writing tags.
  --skip-existing  Skip files that already have ReplayGain tags.
  --track-only     Write each file's track gain and peak only. Album tags are
                   not written, so use this when the directory holds files
                   from more than one album.
  --log LOG        Append changes to this log file (default:
                   $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                   tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log         Do not write the change log.
